data.name: GreenCarbonFactory
data.description: GreenCarbonFactory is an Arnhem-based Dutch startup that installs, owns, and operates small-scale on-site pyrolysis/gasification facilities converting clean local woodchips into green energy (electricity/heat) and EBC-grade biochar for industrial site partners. Founded by Jerom van Roosmalen and Harold Joanknecht, the company operates as a Managed Service Provider and has registered a biochar production project on the Rainbow Standard registry in 2025.
